title: Lens: Important Systems
summary: Read the Lens signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Scan categories, target hints, and tooltip bridges explain what kind of information Lens can expose for the thing in front of you.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch scan target, tooltip wording, unknown states, machine symptoms, hazard clues, and whether the result tells you to prepare, repair, or leave.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Lens system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
